task.description:
Fix the E2E test data format in web/tests/e2e/f2-canvas.e2e.spec.ts. All 13 tests fail because the test helper functions use incorrect GraphNode field names.

Root cause: The backend GraphNode struct (src/definition/graph.zig) has:
  label: ?[]const u8,  (NOT "name")
  attributes: ?[]const u8 = null,  (JSON string, NOT a JSON object)

Fixes needed in the test file:
1. Replace all occurrences of name: "..." in graph node objects with label: "..."
2. Serialize attributes values as JSON strings, e.g. attributes: JSON.stringify({...}) instead of attributes: {...}
3. After fixing, run: cd web && npx playwright test f2-canvas.e2e.spec.ts --reporter=list
4. Confirm at least some tests pass (or get past setup)
acceptance_criteria: At least some E2E tests pass
